notes: Printed: 'Whenever this creature deals combat damage to a player OR PLANESWALKER, look at that many cards ... You may reveal a creature card ... and put it into your hand.' The Harbinger attacks the opponent's Basri Ket (loyalty 6) and deals 4 to it (it survives; the player stays at 20).
